task_definition.task_description: Please look up Alice’s contact details, then check her availability on June 1, 2025, and shortlist a meeting room for 5 people from 9:00 to 10:00. After that, schedule a medium-priority meeting called “Q2 Planning” with Alice and Bob from 9:00 to 10:00 with the description “Quarterly budget review” and set a reminder, then book the best meeting room for that time.
